parsed.rationale: Two near-duplicate computed properties (Jaccard 0.75) both convert `ProcessInfo.ThermalState` to a human-readable string: `ProcessInfo.ThermalState.description` in the sample-app `DebugHUD.swift` (line 237) and `PerformanceControls.thermalStateLabel` in the production `PerformanceControls.swift` (line 152). Because `ProcessInfo.ThermalState` is the shared subject, the canonical fix is a single extension on `ProcessInfo.ThermalState` (e.g., a `var description: String` or `var label: String`) placed in the production `Wallpaper` package, which both the sample app and `PerformanceControls` can then consume. This eliminates the divergence risk where the two string representations drift independently.
